chapter_title_en: The Three Realms Palace – God Tier Divine Abilities
chapter_seo_title: The Eight-Nine Arcane Art: Ji Ning's First Pick at the Three Realms Palace
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning explores the Three Realms Palace's divine abilities, compares the Starseizing Hand to the Eight-Nine Arcane Art, and learns a hard lesson about specialization over greed.
og_title: The Eight-Nine Arcane Art: A Glimpse at the Three Realms Most Powerful Technique
og_description: Ji Ning discovers the origin of the Eight-Nine Arcane Art and understands the true cost of mastering a legendary divine ability.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's First Pick: The Diamond-Indestructible Eight-Nine Arcane Art
twitter_description: Ji Ning explores the Three Realms Palace and chooses the Eight-Nine Arcane Art. But the trial is brutal — much harder than sweeping paths.

lore_anchors.definition: The most supreme divine ability beneath the True God level; a co-creation of the Buddhist and Daoist leaders, intended to push the body to Pangu's level. Also known as the Seventy-Two Transformations.
A state where the body becomes as tough as a magic treasure, so strong that even Pure Yang or Primordial treasures only produce sparks upon striking it.
A top-ten divine ability of the Three Realms; trains only the hands, but has cycles all the way to the True God level.
The highest tier of manually refined magic treasure, above Immortal-ranked and below Primordial treasures.
A treasure born from Heaven and Earth; graded as low, mid, high, and top. Comparable to the utmost limits of a Pure Yang treasure.
The second senior apprentice-brother of Ji Ning, a mad monk who warns him against greed and reminds him to specialize.
The hidden library of Patriarch Subhuti, containing top-tier divine abilities and secret arts; disciples are limited to choosing two or three.
